objectives: At the end of the course, students will be able to discuss the biological system as a controlled combustion process and describe how the process ensures the survival and production of the animals.
At the end of the course, students will be able to appraise the combustion process at both the cellular and animal levels and how this contributes to production.
At the end of the course, students will be able to estimate animal energy use employing various methodologies and approaches.
